entities.name: Jirina Kudro
entities.description: Coppercoat soldier from Ikoria who commands Drannith's defenses and leads survivors during the invasion.

entities.name: General Kudro
entities.description: Jirina's father and leader of the Coppercoats and Drannith; killed by Lukka.

entities.name: Lukka
entities.description: Jirina's fiancé, a bonder who became an outcast and led a beast army.

entities.name: Chevill
entities.description: Assisted Jirina on the way to Lavabrink.

entities.name: Vadrok
entities.description: Monster in whose lair Jirina took shelter.

entities.name: Colonel Bryd
entities.description: Commander of Drannith's forces replaced by Jirina.

entities.name: Battle at the Ozolith
entities.description: Clash between Jirina's and Lukka's forces.

events.summary: Lukka bonds with a winged cat, is banned from Drannith and becomes an outcast.
events.quote: he was banned from Drannith and became an outcast

events.summary: Jirina's and Lukka's forces clash at the Ozolith and Leori saves her.
events.quote: she was ultimately saved by his bonded tiger, Leori

events.summary: Lukka kills General Kudro; Jirina refuses to join him, attacks him and flees to command Drannith's defenses.
Jirina takes over command from Colonel Bryd.
events.quote: Jirina successfully took over command of Drannith's forces from Colonel Bryd

events.summary: Lukka is surrounded by bonders; his use of the Ozolith makes it explode and ignites his spark.
events.quote: resulting in his planeswalker's spark igniting

events.summary: Jirina survives the sacking of Drannith and leads survivors to Lavabrink with Vivien and Chevill.
events.quote: Jirina, survived Lukka's sacking of Drannith, leading the survivors to Lavabrink

events.summary: Vadrok rips Lukka from his flesh-titan and Jirina dissuades Vadrok from attacking the survivors.
events.quote: Jirina dissuaded Vadrok from subsequently attacking the survivors

relations.quote: Jirina is the daughter of the stern General Kudro
since Kudro refused to listen, Lukka killed him
General Jirina Kudro is a Coppercoat soldier from Ikoria .
